question.text: <math> <mrow> <mtext>5</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>ml</mtext></mrow> </math> of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> is mixed with distilled waterand <math> <mrow> <mtext>0</mtext><mtext>.01</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>M</mtext></mrow> </math> solution of an electrolyte <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> so that total volume is <math> <mrow> <mtext>10</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>ml</mtext></mrow> </math>. it was found that all solution containing more than <math> <mrow> <mtext>5</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>ml</mtext></mrow> </math> of <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> coagulate within <math> <mrow> <mtext>5 min</mtext></mrow> </math>. What is the Flocculation value of <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> for <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> sol?

solution.text: A minimum of <math> <mrow> <mtext>5</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>ml</mtext></mrow> </math> of <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> is required to coagulate the sol, the moles of <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> in sol is <math><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>0.01</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0.005</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> this means that a minimum of <math> <mrow> <mtext>0</mtext><mtext>.005</mtext></mrow> </math> moles or <math><mn>0.005</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>1000</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></math> milli moles are required for coagulation 1 litre of sol. flocculation value of <math> <mrow> <mtext>AB</mtext></mrow> </math> for <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> sol = <math> <mtext>5</mtext> </math>
